post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The exp-20260826-001 readiness gate required PIT borrow evidence for every short-side ticker and blocked the whole batch on any miss, while the entity map (sic_peer_index) keeps emitting unlisted/OTC symbols that iBorrowDesk has no page for (fetch_state not_found after an attempted prefetch on the batch day: BAO, DBIM, EVON, HWEP, LILW, SBEV, BAGZ, BLTG, GRAY, MOT) - the very symbols exp-20260913-007 already excludes at admission as unpriceable. So after 09-14 every batch carried 2-8 such tickers out of 20-109 and 13/13 were blocked although 85-98% of the short side was covered; the sleeve never saw a measurement_ready record and the >=20-basket acceptance contract was starving silently (9th/10th silent-starvation pattern: status ok, zero admissions). Excluding and recording uncovered tickers instead of blocking, with the same renormalization pattern as the priceability exclusion, keeps the gate outcome-blind, keeps every persisted record byte-identical (32/32 reproduced) and lifts the hypothetical ready count from 6/32 to 17/32 (7/13 since 09-14).
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not relax the PIT rule (archived_at<=first_seen, 3-day max age), do not convert cross_side_ticker_overlap / polarity / concentration blockers into exclusions under this ID, do not re-evaluate or re-admit any batch first seen before 2026-09-23T17:00:00Z, do not rewrite persisted readiness records or basket decisions, do not read basket PnL to choose which tickers stay, and do not change H10 / 45bp / USD 1000 / 40% / >=20 / >=10.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Only the frozen forward acceptance contract on baskets admitted under this gate: >=20 settled baskets over >=10 decision dates with net PnL after 45bp per leg positive, both chronological halves positive and <=40% single-ticker absolute gross share. Monitoring only (no ID): ready-batch cadence from the 2026-09-24 nightly pass onward (expected ~3-4 ready per week versus ~1 before, from the identity projection) and the uncovered-ticker share per admitted basket; if cross_side_ticker_overlap alone keeps >=50% of post-effective batches blocked over >=20 batches, a separate pre-registered contract review of the overlap rule may be opened (different variable, new ID).
